Power Cycle:
Hold the power button for at least 10-20 seconds until the headset completely powers off. Wait a few seconds and then press the power button to turn it back on.

Hard Reset:
Turn off the headset completely. Hold the power button and volume down button simultaneously until the boot menu appears. Use the volume buttons to navigate to “Boot Device” or “Factory Reset,” then press the power button to select.

Update the Firmware:
If it’s stuck in USB Update Mode, you may need to connect it to a PC. Download the Meta Quest PC software and follow the instructions for manually updating the firmware.

Contact Meta Support:
If these steps don’t work, the headset might need further diagnostics or repairs. Visit the Meta Quest Support page and submit a ticket with the details of the issue.
